title: Boy with Glowing Red Orb
description: A young boy with dark hair and a crescent moon ornament looks down intently at a large glowing red orb resting on a holly leaf in his hands. Ruby-like gems drip from the orb while colorful stylized female profiles and swirling psychedelic patterns fill the background.
prompt: A young Southeast Asian boy with short dark hair wearing a green patterned shirt holds a large glowing red crystalline orb resting on a vibrant holly leaf. Red gems drip from the orb onto his hands. He wears a crescent moon and red jewel in his hair. Behind him are flowing colorful profiles of women in yellow, pink and green against a dark swirling psychedelic background with spirals and crescent moons.
